# WO-113: Replace `any` at checklist parser boundaries (CP-17)
Status: open (worktree cut 2026-11-08 after WO-111/112 merged)

Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)

## Goal
Per CP-17: in web/src/lib/protect.ts replace `any` at the YAML parse/validation boundaries with `unknown` and narrow object/array/string fields before access. Preserve current validation errors where practical, size limits, accepted data, rendered output and build behavior. No output change for current checklist data.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Built site output for /protect/ pages is byte-identical before and after (diff web/dist for those pages and report it).
- pnpm --dir web build, pnpm --dir web check, content_check, tests/test_web_*.py pass; ruff clean.
- Run TypeScript checking only if already supported locally without config changes.
- If no existing no-install harness can exercise the parser, report the gap; do not add tooling.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/lib/protect.ts
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
brokers/checklists.yaml, registry data, scripts, tsconfig, package files, workflows, validation policy, shared components.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
